posts.title: Why Soundcloud?
posts.description: Spent a long, long time wanting to make and release music, not doing it, and when I finally did, I, maybe for about seven or eight years, was a serial oversharer. Like I would just do something, get it to a point where it was good enough, and get it out. SoundCloud was my medium, and I used and abused it. posts.title: Smallest Possible Things That Keep You Going
posts.description: There’s an old Russian story about a woman at the end of the Romantic Age. She went to a high bluff overlooking, I can’t remember if it was a raging river or a vast ocean, and threw herself off. And it was because of the drama. And the wholeness. And the grandeur. posts.title: Beware of Being Musically Bewitched
posts.description: As I write this today, every piece of hardware that used to need regular updating is totally screwed. One thing vibe coding is teaching us all is that so many of these devices have plenty of computing power for what we are asking them to do.
